This is a list of the **fastest animals** in the world, by types of animal.

## Fastest organism

The [peregrine falcon](Peregrine_falcon "Peregrine falcon") is the fastest bird, and the fastest member of the [animal kingdom](Animal "Animal"), with a [diving](Descent_(aeronautics)#Dives "Descent (aeronautics)") speed of over 300 km/h (190 mph).[[1]](Fastest_animals#cite_note-airspacemag.com-1) The fastest land animal is the [cheetah](Cheetah "Cheetah"). Based on my research from Wikipedia, here are the **top 5 fastest animals in the world** and their scientific species names:

| Rank | Animal | Scientific Name | Maximum Speed | Type |
|------|--------|-----------------|---------------|------|
| 1 | **Peregrine Falcon** | *Falco peregrinus* | 389 km/h (242 mph) | Flight-diving |

**Key Notes:**
- The **peregrine falcon** is the fastest member of the entire animal kingdom, achieving its incredible speed during hunting dives (called "stoops")
- The **golden eagle** is also a diving raptor, reaching similar high speeds
- The **white-throated needletail** is notable for allegedly holding the record for fastest level (horizontal) flight
- The **Mexican free-tailed bat** is the fastest mammal in flight and may hold the record for fastest horizontal speed of any animal

It's worth noting that most of the world's fastest animals are birds in flight. If you're interested in different categories, the fastest **land animal** is the **cheetah** (*Acinonyx jubatus*) at about 109-121 km/h (68-75 mph).
